body:
## What it does

Half the work of reporting a fault is working out which channel it belongs in and what detail they want. Describe the problem and it assembles the write-up for the right destination, be that a product fault, a disputed charge, an API failure or the help centre, formatted to drop into the form. Sending stays your move.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Fine_4451 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
